items.title: Louis Armstrong Interview, 1960-08-09
items.q: I was booked in there by a new serial by the name of Mr. Edwald and Mr. Scarrick from Copenhagen, Denmark. They gave me three concerts at night.

ctx.x: When you were in Stockholm, Sweden, I know you draw tremendous crowds. And although I didn't get to see you the last time you were in Stockholm, I know that the audience never lets you leave the stage and repeat all the time. That's right.

One of our biggest successes in Stockholm, you know what I mean? I remember the first time we went there, I was booked in there by a new serial by the name of Mr. Edwald and Mr. Scarrick from Copenhagen, Denmark. They gave me three concerts at night. Our band, Mary Alice and the Gypsy Girls. And all the houses sold out. And after the concert, they had to go in the dining room of my hotel, which is a beautiful hotel that runs all over Europe because my wife traveled with me and everything. And we'd sit down there…
Do you think European people over there have just feeling they're good, though? Anyway, you're worried about it.
